summary: Versamet Royalties Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer trading on NASDAQ and TSX under VMET, furnished a Form 6-K containing a September 16, 2026 news release announcing its addition to the MVIS Global Junior Gold Miners Index (MVGDXJ), the benchmark for the VanEck Junior Gold Miners ETF (GDXJ), effective September 21, 2026, following the close of trading on September 18, 2026, as part of the index's semi-annual review and quarterly rebalance, and the publication of its 2026 Asset Handbook. No transaction, stake, price, premium, advisor, board recommendation or deal terms are stated. This is an index-inclusion and disclosure event, not a special situation; the passive flow from index-tracking funds is the only mechanical angle, while the forward-looking statements and absence of any capital-markets transaction leave no deal or risk-arb angle.
